_doc: Thresholds for .harmony/probe-vupload.sh (s-rta-0929 vupload: .harmony/.reports/s-rta-0929/plan-vupload.md 4.7 + HARMONY ADOPTION VU5-VU11). Rows and calibration: the docstring of .harmony/probe-vupload.py. Fixtures: .harmony/probe-video.json's (the same encoder code, $VIDEO_FIXTURES reuse).
_cycleDetachedMs: u4a: one context cycle per entry; N = ms between the detach and the re-attach (0 = at once; 500 = longer than the decode threads' 250 ms idle park)
_cycleWaitS: u4a: a context cycle re-creates the preview context on the message thread; the new context recompiles every shader (~100s of ms) before gl_context_gen advances
_trimWaitS: u4b: the player is idle kTrimIdleMs (1000 ms) after its last draw; the frame-top scan trims it and its parked decode thread purges -- 2.5 s leaves 1.5 s of margin
_returnSettleS: u4b: after the deck return, wait this long past settle_late and settle again before the steady window (VU5's late == 0 is a steady-state claim; the 4K return catch-ups are w4's bounded hold, printed)
_trimDropMinMb: u4b (b): 4 players x 2 free BGRA 4K slots x 33.2 MB = 265 MB expected; phys_footprint (primary) or ps rss must drop by >= this (plan risk 5: purged IOSurface pages may not leave rss -- both printed)
_u7: adoption VU7: per u7 scene, the lane app's median uploads/s over >= 5 interleaved launches >= u7UploadsRatioMin x the pre-lane app's median, and its median late frames <= the pre-lane app's (.harmony/probe-vupload-ab.sh --u7)
_gopcache: s-rta-0929b gopcache (.harmony/.reports/s-rta-0929b/plan-gopcache.md 4.2 + HARMONY ADOPTION GC2-GC13): every absolute bar below is judged by .harmony/probe-vupload-ab.py on the MEDIAN of >= 5 interleaved launches of the lane app (GC13); a single run prints them as INFO (per-launch values).
_u7ReverseUploadsMin: u7 reverse / turn / flip scenes: uploads/s >= this x the scene's speed (a 30 fps source; 5 % under the content rate)
_u7BracketCt: GC11: the reverse scenes' capture brackets use a code tolerance of 1 frame (probe-video's codeTol 2 elsewhere)
_u7MonoCaps: GC4: back-to-back captures per reverse scene after its window; the codes must decrease strictly, each within its bracket
_u7FwdRatioMin: GC12: the forward-window ping-pong scenes -- the lane app's median uploads/s >= this x the pre-lane app's, and late == 0 in EVERY lane launch
_u7FlipGapMaxMs: GC8: g30_1080_flip_reverse -- the longest upload gap over the window (the forward -> reverse flip inside it) <= this; a1080_g250_flip_reverse: lane median < pre-lane median
_u8: u8 (four 1080p GOP-250 reversers): pooled uploads/s >= u8PooledMin, the slowest player (video_player_uploads) >= u8PerPlayerMin (GC6), late <= u8LateMax, video_gopcache_bytes <= budget + 4 x floorFrames x frameBytes1080, over_budget delta 0, hold 0, pending 0. Under VIDEO_ENV=ADNA_GOPCACHE_BUDGET_MB=256 (GC7): the slowest player >= u8CapPerPlayerMin, late <= u8LateMax, bytes <= 256 MB + floors.
_u9: u9: at s0 bytes >= u9BytesMinMb and <= the budget, frames >= floorFrames (INFO: >= u9FramesFracInfo x 300, adoption S7); after the idle trim bytes / frames / active == 0 and phys_footprint dropped by >= u9FootprintDropFracMin x the counted bytes (GC10); back on screen the code within its bracket, late <= u9LateMax over 3 s
_u11: u11 (GC9): after the switch back to a column of four reversers -- the lane app's median pooled upload gap <= the pre-lane app's (absolute values recorded)
